import hashlib,json,re,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from pypdf import PdfReader
sys.path.insert(0,'reader')
from inventory_contract import control_character_errors

root=Path.cwd();folder=root/'corpus/public/reader/icml2023-decoder';evidence=root/'reader/evidence/twelve-paper-20261001'
candidate_path=evidence/'f06-source-occurrence-candidates.json'
paths=[folder/(n+'.json') for n in ['content','inventory','symbols','issues','paper-metadata','source-occurrence-map','author-transcripts-a1','author-transcripts-main-extra','author-transcripts-extra','author-transcripts-discussion-extra']]
paths+=[folder/'sources/formal.pdf',candidate_path,*sorted((folder/'source-evidence').glob('formal-page-*.txt'))]
before={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
read=lambda n:json.loads((folder/(n+'.json')).read_text())
data=read('content');inventory=read('inventory');rows={r['id']:r for r in data['results']};entries={e['id']:e for e in inventory['entries']};mapping=read('source-occurrence-map');candidates=json.loads(candidate_path.read_text());source_id=candidates['source_id']
occurrences=candidates['source_occurrences'];by_occ={o['occurrence_id']:o for o in mapping};checks=[]
def check(name,value,detail=None):checks.append({'name':name,'passed':bool(value),'detail':detail})
def source_pages(row):return {p for ref in row.get('source_refs',[]) for p in ref.get('pdf_pages',[])}
check('formal-PDF-actual-34-pages',len(PdfReader(folder/'sources/formal.pdf').pages)==34)
check('page-audit-all-34-once',sorted(x['pdf_page'] for x in inventory['page_audit'] if x['source_id']==source_id)==list(range(1,35)))
check('all-independent-occurrence-IDs-preserved-once',len(by_occ)==len(mapping) and {o['occurrence_id'] for o in occurrences} <= set(by_occ))
child=by_occ.get('appendix-a7-selected-updates',{})
check('explicit-A7-update-subdivision',len(mapping)==len(occurrences)+1 and child.get('parent_occurrence_id')=='appendix-a7-updates' and child.get('pdf_pages')==[24,25] and child.get('result_id')=='decoder-one-step-fitting')
refinements={'appendix-a7-updates':[25,26],'main-experimental-metrics':[4,5,8,9]}
for original in occurrences:
 o=by_occ.get(original['occurrence_id'],{});ident=o.get('result_id');row=rows.get(ident);entry=entries.get(ident)
 check('source-occurrence:'+original['occurrence_id'],row is not None and entry is not None and o.get('source_id')==source_id and o.get('pdf_pages')==refinements.get(original['occurrence_id'],original['pdf_pages']) and (not original['candidate_target'] or entry['proof_target'] is True),{'actual_result_id':ident,'pdf_pages':o.get('pdf_pages'),'independent_candidate_target':original['candidate_target'],'actual_target':entry.get('proof_target') if entry else None})
 pages=set(o.get('pdf_pages',[]));missing=pages-source_pages(row or {})
 check('reader-source-pages:'+original['occurrence_id'],not missing,{'missing_pages':sorted(missing),'note':'A coarse independent occurrence may need explicit subdivision when the author splits one proof among multiple results.'} if missing else None)
extra=read('author-transcripts-discussion-extra')
discussion_to_result={'main-natural-image-inference':'decoder-natural-input','main-layer-placement-inference':'decoder-layer-placement','main-depth-experiment-inference':'decoder-depth-growth','appendix-c6':'decoder-cosine-dimension','appendix-c7':'decoder-trained-independence','main-cosine-metrics':'decoder-metrics','main-low-frequency-metric':'decoder-metrics','main-pixel-fitting-metric':'decoder-metrics','appendix-c10-fitting-metric':'decoder-metrics'}
for source in extra['transcripts']:
 ident=discussion_to_result[source['key']];row=rows[ident];text=row['original_statement_md']+'\n\n'+row['original_proof_md']
 check('complete-discussion-extra:'+source['key'],all(not source.get(f) or source[f] in text for f in ['original_statement_md','original_proof_md']) and set(source['source_pages'])<=source_pages(row),{'result_id':ident,'pdf_pages':source['source_pages']})
main={s['key']:s for s in read('author-transcripts-main-extra')['transcripts']};appendix={s['key']:s for s in read('author-transcripts-extra')['transcripts']}
for key,ident in [('main-preliminaries','decoder-preliminaries'),('main-assumption-3.1','decoder-assumption-3-1'),('main-linear-network-setting','decoder-assumption-3-1'),('main-theorem-3.2','decoder-forward-convolution'),('main-corollary-3.3','decoder-cascade-forward'),('main-corollary-3.4','decoder-backpropagation'),('main-assumption-4.1','decoder-independence-scope'),('main-theorem-4.2','decoder-single-channel-moments'),('main-theorem-4.3','decoder-zero-padding'),('main-theorem-4.4','decoder-upsampling'),('main-theorem-4.5','decoder-one-step-fitting')]:
 check('complete-main-author-statement:'+key,main[key]['original_statement_md'] in rows[ident]['original_statement_md'],{'result_id':ident})
for key,ident in [('A.2','decoder-cascade-forward'),('A.3','decoder-backpropagation'),('A.5','decoder-zero-padding'),('A.6','decoder-upsampling'),('B.1','decoder-frequency-preference'),('B.2','decoder-mean-preference'),('B.3','decoder-kernel-preference'),('B.4','decoder-natural-input')]:
 check('complete-appendix-author-proof:'+key,appendix[key]['original_proof_md'] in rows[ident]['original_proof_md'],{'result_id':ident})
parts=re.split(r'(?m)^\(([1-5])\) ',main['main-theorem-4.2-five-conclusions']['original_statement_md'])
conclusion_ids=['decoder-moment-parameter-growth','decoder-depth-growth','decoder-frequency-preference','decoder-mean-preference','decoder-kernel-preference']
for index,ident in enumerate(conclusion_ids,1):
 segment='('+str(index)+') '+parts[index*2]
 check('complete-main-conclusion:'+str(index),re.sub(r'\s+',' ',segment).strip() in re.sub(r'\s+',' ',rows[ident]['original_statement_md']).strip(),{'result_id':ident,'physical_pdf_page':5 if index<3 else 6,'comparison':'Whitespace-normalized complete author segment in original order; no word/formula normalization.'})
norm=lambda s:re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s.replace('**','')).strip()
original_text='\n'.join(r.get('original_statement_md','')+'\n'+r.get('original_proof_md','') for r in rows.values())
for section in ['A.4','A.7']:
 omitted=[line for line in appendix[section]['original_proof_md'].splitlines() if line.strip() and norm(line) not in norm(original_text)]
 check('all-author-lines-across-split:'+section,not omitted,{'omitted_author_lines':omitted})
for source in read('author-transcripts-a1')['transcripts']:
 ident={'lemma-A.1':'decoder-geometric-sum','orthogonality':'decoder-orthogonality','A.1':'decoder-forward-convolution'}[source['key']]
 row=rows[ident];text=row['original_statement_md']+'\n\n'+row['original_proof_md']
 check('complete-A1-author-transcript:'+source['key'],all(not source.get(f) or source[f] in text for f in ['original_statement_md','original_proof_md']),{'result_id':ident,'source_pages':source['source_pages']})
qualifier='Experiments in Section 5.1 have verified the above conclusions in the general case that each convolutional layer contains more than one feature map.'
check('main-five-conclusions-general-case-author-qualifier',qualifier in original_text)
experiment_occurrences=[o for o in mapping if o.get('result_id')=='decoder-experiments']
check('experiment-statement-precise-main9-related-C-appearances-preserved',set(p for o in experiment_occurrences for p in o['pdf_pages']) <= source_pages(rows['decoder-experiments']) and entries['decoder-experiments']['statement_location'].get('pdf_pages')==[9],{'statement_location':entries['decoder-experiments']['statement_location'],'occurrences':experiment_occurrences})
check('declared-new-content-control-characters-zero',not control_character_errors(data))
check('no-known-project-marker-in-author-fields',not any(re.search(r'\bProject source (?:note|synopsis)\s*\(',r.get(f,''),re.I) for r in rows.values() for f in ['original_statement_md','original_proof_md']))
after={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths};check('inputs-unchanged-during-source-review',before==after)
report={'status':'passed_source_boundary_pending_root_admission' if all(x['passed'] for x in checks) else 'requires_source_revision',
 'scope':'Independent author-transcription and exact source-occurrence audit; not mathematical/Lean admission.',
 'recorded_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'reviewed_content_sha256':before['corpus/public/reader/icml2023-decoder/content.json'],
 'inventory_entries':len(entries),'proof_target_entries':sum(e.get('proof_target') is True for e in entries.values()),
 'independent_source_occurrences':len(occurrences),'mapped_occurrences':len(mapping),'discussion_extra_segments':len(extra['transcripts']),
 'explicit_occurrence_refinements':refinements,'checks':checks,'input_hashes':before,
 'review_implementation':{'path':Path(__file__).relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source':Path(__file__).read_text()},
 'previous_report':'reader/evidence/twelve-paper-20261001/f06-source-boundary-review.json',
 'resolved_source_findings':['Eq55 source page26','A4 two Then connecting sentences','Main9 precise experiment statement with separate C/C8/C9 appearances','Metric4/5/8/9 exact appearance refinement','A7 explicit48-50 vs51-55 subdivision','Five conclusions final multi-feature-map author qualifier'],
 'manual_source_distinctions':['Main Eq5 versus Appendix A3 Eq24: original conjugation differences retained.','A4 Gaussian response versus scalar moments versus actual multichannel matrices: separate statements/premises and targets.','A7 Eq48 approximate product versus51-55 updates versus56-57 norm chain: original approximations/errors retained.','C7 heading Assumption3.1 versus body4.1 and seven actual table rows: retained with precise32/33 pages.'],
 'non_target_source_reviews':[{'id':e['id'],'kind':e['kind'],'reason':e['non_proof_reason'],'review':'Definition/model assumptions/metrics/empirical entry; actual inferential and proved claims separately target=true.'} for e in entries.values() if not e['proof_target']],
 'not_admitted':True}
(evidence/'f06-source-boundary-followup.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'content_sha256':report['reviewed_content_sha256'],'checks':len(checks),'failed':[x for x in checks if not x['passed']]},ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(not all(x['passed'] for x in checks))
